trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 describing the rollback.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy with a 0.18 error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
- **Rolled back**: to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy, so it was skipped).
- **Opened incident**: SEV2 INC-0001 for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken.
